title: The Stone Circle
text: Nine standing stones lean together on the hill. In their middle the grass is dry in the rain, and the air is warm and smells of old smoke. Old powers meet here at dusk, and the sun is already low.

options.label: Wait in the circle for dusk to meet the old powers face to face.

outcomes.text: The powers come. They are curious, and kind.
The powers come, and they are not kind.

options.label: The wisest wards the circle so you can sleep in it, safe from what comes.

outcomes.text: You get a full night's sleep, the first in days, and dream of smoke.

options.label: Leave before dusk; the old powers can meet without you.

outcomes.text: Behind you the stones begin to hum. The sound fills you up like a drink.
Behind you the stones begin to hum. All night you feel it in the ground under your camp.

options.label: The Magus stays till dusk to speak with what comes, and learn what it knows.

outcomes.text: The old powers come and speak. The Magus understands one word in three, which is enough.
The old powers come and speak. The Magus understands every word, and wishes they did not.
